response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js, along with strong database knowledge (MongoDB, SQL) and cloud services (AWS). His background in renewable energy/geospatial projects and platform development aligns well with the role's focus. However, his lack of direct PostgreSQL experience and minimal mention of clean architecture practices slightly detract from his fit.
strengths: Proven fullstack development expertise with TypeScript, React, and Node.js across multiple roles
Experience with scalable systems, AWS services, and Kubernetes in production environments
Strong collaborative skills and technical leadership demonstrated through mentoring and open-source contributions
concerns: Limited direct experience with PostgreSQL (only MongoDB/SQL mentioned)
No explicit mention of clean software architecture or pragmatic scaling experience in renewable energy context
Overqualified for an entry-level role (Senior Software Developer experience)
